title: Easy to use!  convenient cup
text: Easy to use!  convenient cup. This is great!  It's easy to use. The handle is comfortable and easy to grip.  Love that the cheese just goes straight into the cup.  The cup comes with a lid to store the shredded cheese. Nice little bonus.
